stories.headline: Romania's post-no-confidence political crisis: government formation deadlock as parties fail to agree on new prime minister
stories.summary: Following the PSD-AUR motion of no confidence that toppled the Bolojan government, Romania entered a prolonged government formation crisis. President Nicușor Dan held consultations at Cotroceni with all parliamentary parties; PSD under Sorin Grindeanu sought a political or technocratic PM, AUR's George Simion requested a government mandate, PNL and USR refused to join any government including PSD, and PNL warned that a designation was expected within days.

stories.headline: PNL marks 151 years amid internal feud over identity, Bolojan's leadership, and break from 'PSD-ism'
stories.summary: The National Liberal Party held its 151st anniversary at Vila Florica and across Romania, with interim PM Ilie Bolojan calling for deep reorganization and declaring austerity the reason his government was ousted. PNL vice-president Ciprian Ciucu called for the party to shed 'PSD-ism,' while internal critics Hubert Thuma and Lucian Bode challenged Bolojan's authority, and former PNL president Crin Antonescu attacked the current leadership from outside.

stories.headline: Romanian F-16 shoots down suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia during NATO Baltic Air Policing mission
stories.summary: On May 19, a Romanian F-16 from the Carpathian Vipers squadron, deployed on NATO's Baltic Air Policing mission in Lithuania, intercepted and shot down a drone that had entered Estonian airspace — the first time a NATO fighter jet has downed a drone over Alliance territory. Ukraine blamed Russian electronic jamming for steering its drone off course and apologized; Russia threatened retaliation against Latvia and Baltic states.

stories.headline: NATO foreign ministers meet in Sweden amid US troop withdrawal plans; Rutte pitches procurement-for-commitment deal with Trump
stories.summary: NATO foreign ministers gathered in Helsingborg, Sweden, following the Trump administration's announcement that it intends to reduce forces committed to NATO crisis response. Secretary General Rutte sought to keep the US engaged by offering increased US defence procurement contracts, while European allies discussed contingency planning. Romania's defence minister and military were cited in related coverage.

stories.headline: BNR raises 2026 inflation forecast to 5.5%, warns political vacuum threatens economic stability
stories.summary: The National Bank of Romania revised its 2026 year-end inflation forecast sharply upward to 5.5% (from 3.9%), driven by Middle East energy shocks and leu depreciation, as Governor Mugur Isărescu warned that prolonged government formation would compound instability. Isărescu stated BNR's exchange-rate interventions this spring were much smaller than in 2025, that the current euro rate is near equilibrium, and that fiscal correction remains essential.

stories.headline: Romania's SAFE-funded defence procurement disputed: warship acquisition and influence peddling allegations
stories.summary: Romania's Ministry of Defence justified acquiring two Turkish-designed MMPV 90 patrol vessels under the EU SAFE programme over a Dutch Damen offer, while opposition PSD accused Vice-PM Oana Gheorghiu and a German law firm of influence peddling in SAFE contract advisory. Defence Minister Miruță warned that bureaucratic delays could cause loss of SAFE-funded contracts; Romania's total SAFE allocation was cited at €16.68 billion.

stories.summary: AUR senate leader Petrișor Peiu and economic analyst Petrișor Peiu (same person) publicly condemned Romania's commitments under the US-backed SMR project at Doicești and the Cernavodă reactors 3 and 4, calling them economically ungrounded and warning of a financial and energy crisis. Former PMs including Ciolacu were named as politically responsible.

stories.headline: Romania's external debt reaches record €231.5 billion in Q1 2026; current account deficit narrows
stories.summary: The National Bank of Romania reported that total external debt rose to €231.5 billion at end-Q1 2026, up €3 billion from year-end 2025, while the current account deficit shrank to €5.3 billion in Q1 — down from €6.15 billion in Q1 2025. Foreign direct investment fell sharply to €1.13 billion in Q1.

stories.headline: SRI directorate vacancy analysed in context of political crisis and past intelligence manipulation allegations
stories.summary: Two analytical pieces revisited the resignation of former SRI director Eduard Hellvig and Romania's prolonged failure to appoint a successor under either Klaus Iohannis or Nicușor Dan, linking the vacancy to Romania's declining NATO-partner standing and ongoing political instability. A separate investigation alleged George Simion was a past SRI-funded activist later recruited by Kremlin.

stories.headline: Fertilizer price crisis hits Romania: Azomureș cited as critical, EU Commission plan welcomed
stories.summary: Rising fertilizer prices — partly attributed to Strait of Hormuz disruptions nearly doubling prices — prompted warnings from the Romanian Farmers' Club and Agriculture Minister Tanczos Barna that Azomureș is the only domestic solution. The EU Commission's fertilizer support plan was welcomed, but farmers called for immediate CBAM suspension and Romgaz-Azomureș negotiations.
